instruction:
Use the ANSYS Workbench GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: rigid sphere pressing an elastic plate, validating Hertz contact pressure.

Model parameters:
- Sphere: radius 10 mm, material Structural Steel
- Plate: 100 mm x 100 mm x 10 mm, material Structural Steel
- Mesh: local refinement to 0.3 mm in contact region, 2 mm elsewhere

Boundary conditions and load:
- Bottom face of plate: fixed
- Top of sphere: concentrated force 500 N in Y direction toward the plate
- Contact type: Frictionless, contact algorithm Augmented Lagrange or Pure Penalty

Analysis type: nonlinear static analysis with large deflection enabled

Save requirements:
- Workbench project file: wb_hertz.wbpj
- The project directory must include contact analysis results
